spotify_setup_guide:
1. Open developer.spotify.com/dashboard and sign in.
2. Create an application and select Web API.
3. Add exactly this Redirect URI in the app settings:
http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback
4. Copy the Client ID and paste it below. No Client Secret is needed.
5. Click Connect and authorize in your browser. In development mode, add your account to authorized users if Spotify requires it.
API playback requires Premium and is subject to Spotify’s current permissions and restrictions.
